items.title: Corn Ear with Emerging Silks
items.alt: A young corn ear is wrapped in green husks with a long tuft of reddish-brown silks and an attached arching leaf.
items.description: A young corn ear is wrapped in green husks with a long tuft of reddish-brown silks and an attached arching leaf. Use this isolated illustration in a personal corn-themed design or classroom vocabulary activity.
